title: Quantum Anchor V1.2 — Tesseract Anchor Protocol and Measurement Ledger
description: Experimental protocol for coherent state anchoring on superconducting QPUs, together with the measurement ledger that tests it. The original pulse-level protocol (qiskit.pulse, meas_level=0) was deprecated by IBM in 2024 and removed from production QPUs in February 2025. V1.2 migrates to working APIs and reports evidence grades honestly. MEASURED RESULTS: single-qubit dynamics psi(37ns)=0.331662 under a gamma=0 model on ibm_marrakesh (156Q Heron r2); four independent Bell pairs at 95-96% per-plane balance on IQM Resonance Garnet 19Q using a virtual Z rotation of 0.4398 rad. NEGATIVE RESULTS, documented in full: the corrected anchor-on (gamma=0.5) and anchor-off (gamma=0) conditions both yield 0% clear, and the global 8-qubit correlation is 11.62%, consistent with statistically independent planes. The physical anchor-drive compensation effect is NOT proven by any measurement in this work; pulse-level access required to test it was measured to be unavailable on the account tier used. An earlier positive result is retracted as a circuit tautology. The Tesseract architecture (4 planes x 5 phase realities = 20 pre-realities) is a design proposal whose synchronized selection has NOT been demonstrated.
